description: Daily mean sea-surface temperature over the ocean between 60° S and 60° N since 1 January 1979 from the ERA5 reanalysis, as the difference from the 1991–2020 average for the same day of the year. The newest days can be preliminary.

processing.description: Read the Climate Pulse daily series of 60°S–60°N sea-surface temperature from ERA5, last updated by C3S on 05 October 2026, from 1979-01-01 to 2026-10-03.
Published the producer's anomaly from its smoothed 1991–2020 daily climatology (column ano_91-20) unchanged, rounded as printed (three decimals).

Kept the file's status of each day: 0 day(s) marked PRELIMINARY are published as preliminary, because the file states that their values will likely change slightly once the final ERA5 data for the day are available.

scope.baseline: 1991–2020 daily climatology of this dataset, smoothed by C3S
scope.basis: ERA5 reanalysis; daily mean sea-surface temperature.
scope.geography: Ocean between 60° S and 60° N (area mean)

title: Sea-surface temperature against 1991–2020, 60° S–60° N, daily (ERA5 Climate Pulse)
